updates.note: Guidance was toned down to INR 4,000 crores in Q3 and actual revenue for FY26 came in around INR 3,626 crores.
updates.quote: In the third quarter, I think we have turned out to saying about INR4,000 crores because of a few delays.

updates.note: Working capital days stood around 122 days in FY26 due to the metering segment.
updates.quote: We realized our working capital days stood at around 122 days in FY '26

new_promises.statement: OSAT Unit 2 is in commercialization by Q2 2026.
new_promises.quote: Unit 1 is fully operational, and Unit 2 is in commercialization by Q2 '26.
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

new_promises.statement: Increase NPD-led and value-added solutions contribution to nearly 30% of total revenue in coming years.
new_promises.quote: our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD-led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.
new_promises.speaker: N. Muthukumar

new_promises.statement: PCB business for FY27 expected around INR 300 crores to INR 400 crores.
new_promises.quote: a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
new_promises.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

new_promises.statement: OSAT business for FY27 expected around INR 250 crores to INR 300 crores.
